recognize_zh: 血液抹片中箭頭所指的紅血球內含深染、兩端平直的長方形棒狀結晶（Hb C crystals），周圍還有許多靶形紅血球（target cells，星號）；「結晶＋大量靶形細胞」是血紅素 C 病的典型組合。
features: Several dense, homogeneous, rectangular/bar-shaped Hb C crystals with parallel sides and blunt ends, within red cell membranes (arrows)
Some crystals leave a pale empty remnant of the red cell membrane adjacent to the crystal
Numerous target cells with central hemoglobinized 'bull's-eye' (stars)
Occasional folded cells and dense spherocyte-like red cells
Scattered platelets; no sickle cells seen in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous target cells and several red cells containing dense, homogeneous, rectangular intracellular crystals with parallel sides and blunt ends, some displacing the remaining hemoglobin to leave a pale membrane remnant. Occasional folded and hyperdense red cells are present, and platelets appear adequate. No classic sickle cells are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin C disease; hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC is required to distinguish Hb CC from Hb SC.

ddx.vs: Hb SC also shows crystals and target cells but characteristically has irregular 'Washington monument' or glove-shaped SC crystals and occasional sickle forms; electrophoresis confirms.
Hb SS shows elongated, pointed-ended sickle cells rather than straight-sided rectangular crystals within intact membranes.

ddx.dx: Target cells from liver disease or thalassemia
ddx.vs: These show target cells but no intraerythrocytic hemoglobin crystals.

ddx.dx: Artifactual overlapping red cells or stain precipitate
ddx.vs: Overlapping cells show two superimposed circular outlines, whereas Hb C crystals are sharp-edged rectangles within a single cell outline.
